basics.name: Marko Ahola
basics.label: Principal Software Engineer
basics.summary:
Marko is a seasoned software architect and full-stack developer with experience from mobile apps to cloud infrastructure. He builds scalable, maintainable systems and contributes to impactful open-source projects.

He has worked in both startups and large organizations, bridging technical and non-technical teams to ensure alignment and strong delivery. In addition to technical leadership, Marko brings solid management experience, leading teams, mentoring developers, and driving collaboration. His combined technical and managerial insight makes him valuable to any team focused on results and long-term success.

x-strengths.title: End-to-End Ownership
x-strengths.description: Led end-to-end development of complex systems, owning architecture, delivery, and team direction.

x-strengths.title: Team Leadership & Scaling
x-strengths.description: Scaled teams (4–10 engineers) and improved delivery through mentoring, process improvements, and product-focused development.

x-strengths.title: Product-Driven Engineering
x-strengths.description: Strong product mindset. Connects business goals to technical solutions and to measurable impact.

x-keyRoles.title: Engineering Manager
x-keyRoles.description: Led cross-functional teams, aligning engineering with business goals. Owned delivery, planning, and team performance.

x-keyRoles.title: Senior / Staff Engineer
x-keyRoles.description: Designed scalable systems and improved legacy architectures. Strong ownership across backend, frontend, infrastructure and developer experience.

x-keyRoles.title: Lead Developer
x-keyRoles.description: Owned architecture and delivery in complex regulated systems. Mentored developers and improved engineering practices.

x-keySkills.title: AI experience
x-keySkills.description:
Applied AI in code generation, testing, and refactoring workflows with strong guardrails. Focus on developer experience and validity.

Rapidly build and ship products using AI-assisted development workflows. Improve productivity with AI in regulated environments.

work.name: Own sole proprietorship
work.summary: Short part-time projects of up to 4 months.

projects.name: Full-stack development and integrations
projects.description: Designed and developed functionality across the full technology stack, including complex internal and external integrations. Contributed to technical planning, system design, implementation, testing, and infrastructure. Improved engineering effectiveness through better development processes, tooling, architecture, technical practices, and observability.

projects.name: Product engineering and team leadership
projects.x-note: The project list gives 2020-2023, the highlight slide 2020-2024; the project list dates are used.
projects.description: Led teams of 4–10 engineers across multiple product domains, improving delivery and team performance. Evolved backend systems from simple implementations to scalable, production-grade architecture. Improved reliability and development speed through better observability, processes, and system design.

projects.name: Modular CRM system
projects.description: Designed and developed a modular CRM system in a regulated financial domain. Defined architecture for extending a monolithic system with modular features. Worked hands-on across backend and frontend as part of a delivery team.

projects.name: Financial digitalization project
projects.description: Large multi-year digitalization project for a financial sector customer. Led development of a system in the project and designed the service architecture, integrations and core domain logic. Included developing web-based applications, improving the customer's software development processes in a regulated environment, and designing and executing a hiring and mentoring program to grow the customer's own development team.

projects.name: Job collaboration platform
projects.description: Development of a job collaboration platform for universities, companies and talents and help take it to production.

projects.name: Data handling platform prototype
projects.description: Prototype of a data handling platform with new platforms for a large enterprise company. Created example projects for internal development teams.

projects.name: Code club
projects.description: Teaching Digital technology to 5th graders (2h per week). Designing the lectures and preparation of the materials.

projects.name: Short freelance projects
projects.description: Short projects, max 4 months, part-time work, e.g. developing a cross-platform application for a sports equipment company, designing a platform for a modular application for a finance institution, and a prototype of a system for distributed workload handling for an engineering company.

projects.name: Laboratory system software platform
projects.x-note: The project list gives 2019-2020 (same as the previous project on the slide, likely a copy error); the highlight slide gives 2012-2015, which is used.
projects.description: Lead Developer and architect of a .NET software platform for laboratory systems, to control instruments and handle data. Designed and built the modular platform from scratch, replacing multiple legacy systems with a unified, extensible architecture. This improved maintainability and enabled faster feature development across multiple use cases. Project team of 5–10 developers and project size ~15 man-years.

projects.name: Cross-platform desktop application
projects.description: Developing a cross platform desktop application. Improving concurrent processing of data calculations.

projects.name: Business intelligence platform development
projects.description: Developing functionality to a business intelligence platform. Design and development of a light weight mobile site for the platform.

projects.name: RFID reader application
projects.description: Developing an application for reading information from RFID tags and communicating with backend server for a handheld Windows CE device.

projects.name: Point of Sale system
projects.description: Requirement specifications and developing a Point of Sale system with .NET-technology. Implementing database procedures. Participating in the improvement of department’s software development process.

projects.name: .NET application development
projects.description: Developing applications with .NET, mainly with C#. Usage of 3-Tier (Client-Server) architecture. Improving TFS Continuous Integration. Acting as a Scrum Master.

projects.name: Engineering plan selection application
projects.description: Creating an application for mechanical engineers for selecting and previewing technical plans. Developing an application for migrating data between databases.
